newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona May cargo traffic rose 7 pct to 7,035 to.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona May cargo traffic rose 7 pct to 7,035 to.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport rose 7.3 percent in May, following a rise of 15.8 percent in April compared with the same month in 1996, the airport authority said.
The May total of 7,035 tonnes takes the accumulated cargo volume so far this year to 35,139 tonnes, 12.8 percent more than the first five months of 1996.

Non European Union international freight was still the fastest growing area with a 28 percent increase in May to 1,024 tonnes, while the volume of domestic cargo fell 2.4 percent to 2,915 tonnes and European Union cargo grew 11.7 percent to 3,096 tonnes.

Passenger numbers, excluding transit passengers, rose 15.9 percent to 1.27 million in the month, taking the year to date total to 5.61 million, up 13.9 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
